Usage: codexui [options] [command] [projectPath]

Web interface for Codex app-server

Arguments:
  projectPath                 project directory to open on launch

Options:
  --open-project <path>       open project directory on launch (Codex desktop
                              parity)
  -p, --port <port>           port to listen on (default: "5900")
  --password <pass>           set a specific password
  --no-password               disable password protection
  --strict-port               fail when the requested port cannot be bound
                              (default: false)
  --open                      open browser on startup (default: true)
  --no-open                   do not open browser on startup
  --memories                  enable Codex memories for spawned app-server
                              processes (default: true)
  --no-memories               disable Codex memories for spawned app-server
                              processes
  --sandbox-mode <mode>       Codex sandbox mode: read-only, workspace-write,
                              danger-full-access
  --approval-policy <policy>  Codex approval policy: untrusted, on-failure,
                              on-request, never
  -h, --help                  display help for command

Commands:
  help                        Show codexui command help
